headline: OpenAI employee arrested after hidden recording device found in office
summary: An OpenAI engineer, identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, was arrested after the company found a hidden recording device in its offices and referred the matter to the FBI. The FBI's director said the scheme aimed to capture sensitive communications about the company's 'super intelligence' technology; OpenAI used its own AI models to help identify the device, and chatbot prompts allegedly reveal the engineer's efforts to set it up in a room used by executives.
